caption: The drawing depicts a large, detailed golden-brown bird, likely an eagle, perched on a grayish horizontal branch or rod. The eagle has its wings spread wide, with feathers intricately sketched and shaded to show texture and layers. The bird’s head is turned to the right and downward, with its beak open and holding a black ring or loop. Its talons are gripping the branch and part of the black ring. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. In the lower right corner, there is small handwritten text identifying “Mary E. Thomas” and “Art Project of Virginia.”
title: Stern Piece: Eagle
